description: Use when enabling, configuring, or troubleshooting Person Accounts in a Salesforce org — includes B2C data model design, IsPersonAccount flag handling, Account-Contact behavior differences, reporting impact, migration planning, and integration requirements. NOT for standard B2B Account/Contact modeling - use data/data-model-design-patterns.
inputs: Whether Person Accounts is already enabled in the org or this is a new enablement request
Current org edition and existing Account/Contact record volumes
Whether the org is B2B-only, B2C-only, or mixed (B2B + B2C)
Integration systems and whether they query via Account or Contact objects
Whether Health Cloud, FSC, or another industry cloud is in use
name: person-accounts
official_sources: Salesforce Object Reference 264 L12855-12861 (`IsPersonAccount` read-only), L13415-13419 and L13481-13487 (person fields and `PersonContactId`), L71925 (`Contact.IsPersonAccount`), plus Apex Developer Guide 264 L7413-7414, L9185, L11034, L15724 and L15748-15749 (creation, Name, schema tokens, trigger firing) and Metadata API 264 L89963-89965 and L100866-100870 (matching rule, enablement request)
Salesforce Object Reference — Person Account sObject, IsPersonAccount field, PersonContact behavior
Salesforce Help: Enable Person Accounts — prerequisites, enablement steps, record type requirements
Salesforce Well-Architected Overview — architecture quality framing, scalability and reliability pillars
Salesforce Architects: Data Model Design — B2C data model patterns, Person Account architectural guidance
outputs: B2C data model design recommendation (Person Account vs standard Account+Contact)
IsPersonAccount handling guidance for Apex and API code
Reporting adjustment plan for Contact-based reports
Migration approach for converting existing Contact-only records to Person Accounts
Integration guidance for external systems consuming Person Account data
